heavybag-list-entry-counts.description: Entries per shipped classifier list under modules/ngx_http_heavybag/lists/: every line that is neither blank nor a '#' comment (one pattern, token or CIDR per line; a trailing action token does not add an entry). Rendered as a markdown table.

regression-fixture-census.description: Size of the committed C regression fixture: path/args vectors (regression-vectors.jsonl lines), header vectors (regression-headers.jsonl lines), and the frozen expected_status distribution across both files.
command:
$n{$ARGV =~ /headers/ ? q{h} : q{v}}++; $s{$1}++ if /"expected_status":(\d+)/; END { printf qq{Current frozen fixture: **%d** path/args vectors + **%d** header vectors (`expected_status` 404: %d, 403: %d, 444: %d).
}, $n{v}, $n{h}, $s{404}, $s{403}, $s{444} }
